reviews.text: It’s labeled "Grape," but it was actually quite brown. Rather than having blue undertones, it had a muted, dusty quality.
reviews.zh: 標籤寫住「Grape」，但實際係偏啡色。冇藍調，反而係沉鬱、帶灰霧感嘅色調。

reviews.text: easy to blend, and layers nicely without looking patchy. The matte shades are soft and buildable, while the shimmer adds a pretty, subtle glow without being too intense.
reviews.zh: 容易推開，多層疊擦都唔會斑駁。霧面色調柔和、可以逐層疊加，而亮片就加咗一抹精緻嘅微光，唔會太誇張。

reviews.text: Love the colours and the cute packaging, but will need to try again, as I’m not sure if they made my eyelids puffy and irritated the day I wore them. I did have something underneath and it might have been that, so I’ll definitely try again, as the colouring and coverage is great.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意啲色同埋個包裝好可愛，但要再試多次先確定，因為唔知當日用完係咪令眼皮腫同敏感。當日底下我有搽其他嘢，可能係嗰樣嘅問題，所以一定會再試，因為顯色度同遮瑕度都好好。

reviews.text: This eye palette has a nice mix of shades that are easy to use for different looks. The colors apply smoothly and blend well on the eyes.
reviews.zh: 呢個眼影盤嘅色調配搭好，唔同妝容都好易用。色澤順滑易推，眼上都好易推開。

reviews.text: This eye palette comes in a compact size that is easy to carry around for touch-ups. The shades blend well together and are great for creating simple everyday eye looks.
reviews.zh: 呢個眼影盤size細，方便攜帶補妝。色調之間容易推開，好適合化簡單嘅日常眼妝。

reviews.text: have tried the swatches on and the pigment was quite light but i also expected it as the colours do seem to be leaning towards a lighter palette so i dont really mind. Very cute packaging and portable.
reviews.zh: 試過上手，顯色度比較淡，但因為啲色睇落本身就偏淺色tone，所以都預咗，唔太介意。包裝好可愛又便攜。

reviews.text:
IMPORTANT! IF YOU LIKE HIGHLY PIGMENTED EYESHADOW LIKE WESTERN EYESHADOW THIS IS NOT FOR YOU.
 
I love how subtle it is. It's super easy for no makeup makeup. Which is my preferred style. However like I said earlier if you like highly pigmented eyeshadow like we have in the west this is 100% not for you
reviews.zh:
重要！如果你好似西方眼影咁鍾意高顯色嘅眼影，呢個就唔啱你。
 
我就好鍾意佢嘅低調感，輕鬆做到偽素顏妝，正正係我鍾意嘅風格。但好似我頭先講，如果你鍾意好似西方眼影嗰種高顯色嘅效果，呢個100%唔啱你。

reviews.text: This package is so cute, that’s why I got it but honestly, it’s pretty rubbish quality. Pretty weak for every thing
reviews.zh: 包裝好可愛，所以我先買，但講真質素好差。樣樣都唔得。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
